caption: The drawing depicts two metallic spoons positioned horizontally and parallel to one another, centered on a plain off-white or light beige background. Both spoons are drawn in a realistic grayscale style, showing shading and reflective surfaces. The handles of both spoons are on the right side of the image, with their bowls oriented to the left. Each spoon has an engraved marking on the right end of the handle. The top spoon has a rounded bowl and a smooth, tapering handle with some text or marks engraved near the end. The bottom spoon is similar in size and shape, also with a rounded bowl and handle, and features engraved text that appears to read "WMN" at the end of the handle. In the lower left corner of the image, the name "Walton K" is inscribed, also in black-and-white.
title: Silver Teaspoon
